goal.raw_text: Process the claim submitted by the VSP after receiving collected claim forms monthly.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
The VSP has completed the service (treatment) at their clinic or hospital.
The attending doctor has filled the claims form.
On completion of the service, the patient has provided the voucher according to the visit type and patient type (client or partner), and the voucher is stuck to the claim form.
The thumb print has been placed on completion of the service.
The VSP has collected the claim forms monthly and sent them to the MSIU field office.
The system has VSP master information configured, including VSP Code and Providers Name.
The system has Staff Master configured with Staff Code (VSP Code + SC + 3 digit suffix) and Staff Type selected from Staff Type Master.
The Claim (Treatment Form) submission depends on payment terms (Bi-monthly / Monthly) mentioned in the VSP master.
All mandatory information for claim submission (other than Qualification) must be available, as qualification is not mandatory during new staff creation under any VSP.
The VSP sends the collected claim forms monthly to the MSIU field office.

trigger.raw_text: The VSP sends the collected claim forms monthly to the MSIU field office.

claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User receives the collected claim forms from the VSP.
The system validates and checks every capture of data on saving into the database, including voucher number, clinical information, diagnosis details, drug and investigation details, and costs.
The system processes the claim after validation.

If any of the staff type is not available in the system, then the system should have the provision to navigate quickly to staff type master to enter the new staff type and then back to Staff Master screen.
If any mandatory information is missed or any false information is existing, then the field office will reject the claim back to VSP and the system will keep those claims in a quarantine area.

The quarantined forms will be sent back to the VSP for verification; if the VSP returns the claim with satisfactory details, the claims will be entered on to the system, in the following month's batch.
System only accepts claims only if the mandatory information is complete.
